# Layer 4: Data Flow

This document traces primary data paths through ChainVault — how payments enter the system, move through processing, interact with the Bitcoin network, and persist to the database.

## Domain Model Overview

```mermaid
graph LR
    user["ApplicationUser"]:::component
    wallet["Wallet"]:::component
    tx["PaymentTransaction"]:::component
    utxo["Utxo"]:::component
    escrow["Escrow"]:::component
    idem["IdempotencyKeyRecord"]:::component

    user -->|"owns many"| wallet
    wallet -->|"has many"| utxo
    wallet -->|"participates in"| tx
    tx -->|"may have"| escrow
    tx -->|"consumes/creates"| utxo
    idem -->|"guards"| tx

    classDef component fill:#85bbf0,stroke:#5d82a8,color:#000000
```

## Payment Flows

### Charge Flow (Direct Payment)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant API as API
    participant H as ChargeHandler
    participant BTC as Bitcoin Network

    C->>API: POST /api/v1/payments/charge
    API->>H: CreateChargeCommand
    H->>H: Sync buyer UTXOs
    H->>H: Select coins (largest-first)
    H->>H: Build & sign transaction
    H->>BTC: Broadcast raw tx
    BTC-->>H: txid + explorer URL
    H->>H: Mark UTXOs spent
    H-->>C: PaymentResponse (state: mempool)

    Note over BTC: Blocks mined...
    BTC-->>H: ConfirmationWatcher polls
    H->>H: Update confirmations
    H-->>H: state: settled (after N confirmations)
```

### Authorize / Capture / Void Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant API as API
    participant H as Handlers
    participant BTC as Bitcoin Network

    C->>API: POST /api/v1/payments/authorize
    API->>H: CreateAuthCommand
    H->>H: Build 2-of-2 multisig escrow
    H->>BTC: Broadcast funding tx
    BTC-->>H: txid
    H-->>C: AuthorizationResponse (state: funding_broadcast)

    Note over BTC: Funding confirms...
    H->>H: state: auth_active

    alt Capture
        C->>API: POST /api/v1/payments/capture
        API->>H: CaptureAuthCommand
        H->>H: Spend escrow to merchant
        H->>BTC: Broadcast capture tx
        H-->>C: PaymentResponse (state: capture_broadcast)
    else Void
        C->>API: POST /api/v1/payments/void
        API->>H: VoidAuthCommand
        H->>H: Return escrow to buyer
        H->>BTC: Broadcast void tx
        H-->>C: PaymentResponse (state: void_broadcast)
    end
```

### Refund Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant API as API
    participant H as RefundHandler
    participant BTC as Bitcoin Network

    C->>API: POST /api/v1/payments/refund
    API->>H: CreateRefundCommand
    H->>H: Verify parent is settled
    H->>H: Check refund doesn't exceed original
    H->>H: Sync merchant UTXOs
    H->>H: Build refund tx (merchant -> buyer)
    H->>BTC: Broadcast
    H-->>C: PaymentResponse (state: mempool)
```

### Transfer Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant API as API
    participant R as TransferStrategyResolver
    participant BTC as Bitcoin Network

    C->>API: POST /api/v1/transfers
    API->>R: Resolve strategy (auto/onchain/internal)

    alt Internal (same user)
        R->>R: InternalLedgerStrategy
        R->>R: Debit source, credit destination
        R-->>C: TransferResponse (state: transfer_completed)
    else On-chain (different users)
        R->>R: OnChainTransferStrategy
        R->>R: Build & sign transaction
        R->>BTC: Broadcast
        BTC-->>R: txid
        R-->>C: TransferResponse (state: mempool)
    end
```

## Transaction State Machine

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Created
    Created --> Mempool: Charge/Refund broadcast
    Created --> FundingBroadcast: Auth funding broadcast

    Mempool --> Confirming: 1+ confirmations
    Confirming --> Settled: N confirmations reached

    FundingBroadcast --> FundingConfirmed: 1+ confirmations
    FundingConfirmed --> AuthActive: Funding confirmed
    FundingBroadcast --> AuthActive: 1+ confirmations

    AuthActive --> CaptureBroadcast: Capture
    AuthActive --> VoidBroadcast: Void
    AuthActive --> Expired: Timelock expired

    CaptureBroadcast --> Settled: N confirmations
    VoidBroadcast --> VoidConfirming: 1+ confirmations
    VoidConfirming --> Voided: N confirmations

    Created --> Failed: Error
    Mempool --> Failed: Error
```

## Data Persistence Model

### Core Tables

| Table | Key Columns | Purpose |
|-------|-------------|---------|
| `Wallets` | Id, UserId, Name, MasterPublicKey, NextAddressIndex | HD wallet with encrypted master key, user-scoped |
| `PaymentTransactions` | Id, BuyerWalletId, MerchantWalletId, AmountSatoshis, State, TxId | All payment operations (charge, auth, capture, void, refund, transfer) |
| `Utxos` | Id, WalletId, TxId, OutputIndex, AmountSatoshis, IsSpent | Tracked UTXOs for coin selection |
| `Escrows` | Id, TransactionId, FundingTxId, RedeemScript, State | 2-of-2 multisig escrow for authorize/capture/void |
| `IdempotencyKeyRecords` | Key, Response, CreatedAt | Deduplication of payment requests |

### Identity Tables (ASP.NET Core Identity)

| Table | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `AspNetUsers` | User accounts (extends IdentityUser as ApplicationUser) |
| `RefreshTokens` | JWT refresh token storage with expiry tracking |

### Data Flow Paths

| Flow | Write Path | Read Path |
|------|-----------|-----------|
| **Wallet creation** | API → WalletApplicationService → WalletRepository → PostgreSQL | API → WalletRepository → PostgreSQL |
| **UTXO sync** | Mempool.space → WalletSynchronizationService → UtxoRepository → PostgreSQL | CoinSelectionService → UtxoRepository → PostgreSQL |
| **Payment execution** | Handler → TransactionBuilderService → NBitcoin → Mempool.space (broadcast) → TransactionRepository → PostgreSQL | API → PaymentQueryService → TransactionRepository → PostgreSQL |
| **Confirmation tracking** | ConfirmationWatcher → Mempool.space (poll) → TransactionRepository → PostgreSQL | Automatic (background) |
| **Auth expiry** | AuthExpiryMonitor → TransactionRepository → PostgreSQL | Automatic (background) |
